issue_context.title: Cluster in-mem table query is slow when there are empty tidb nodes in etcd
issue_context.body:
## Background

We found that the query latency of Slow Query and SQL Statements in TiDB Dashboard was high in a cloud cluster, and the reason is that TiDB nodes with empty IP addresses often appear in etcd. So queries to `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CLUSTER_SLOW_QUERY` will get stuck on coprocessor requests until they time out.

Empty TiDB nodes are created by BR.

## Solution

We first need to solve the problem of BR generating empty nodes, which is already in progress. But the robustness of TiDB itself also needs to be improved. Instead of waiting for a timeout, we should choose to skip or report an error immediately when encountering an empty node.
